2.325.2
DataSet.AccentSensitivity
The DataSet.AccentSensitivity element indicates whether data in a DataSet is accent-sensitive. This
element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be one of the following:
Auto (default): The accent-sensitivity setting is autoderived by querying the data provider. If the
data provider does not support autoderivation, this value is interpreted as false.
True: Data in the dataset is accent-sensitive.
False: Data in the dataset is accent-insensitive.
If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "Auto".
Following is the parent element for the DataSet.AccentSensitivity element.
Parent elements
DataSet
The following is the XML Schema definition of the DataSet.AccentSensitivity element.
 <xsd:element name="AccentSensitivity" minOccurs="0">
   <xsd:simpleType>
     <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string">
       <xsd:enumeration value="True" />
       <xsd:enumeration value="False" />
       <xsd:enumeration value="Auto" />
     </xsd:restriction>
   </xsd:simpleType>
 </xsd:element>
